mapper.select: SELECT j.CMPY_SEQ AS cmpySeq, IFNULL(c.CMPY_NAME, '') AS cmpyName, IFNULL(c.BSNS_RGNMB, '') AS bsnsRgnmb, IFNULL(FN_MEM_NAME(SUBSTRING( MAX(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(q.ISSUE_DT, '%Y%m%d'), IFNULL(j.MNG_ID, ''))), 9)), '-') AS lastMngName, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(q.QUO_YM, '-', q.QUO_SEQ)) AS orders, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ti.TEST_TYPE_CODE ORDER BY ti.TEST_TYPE_CODE SEPARATOR ',') AS deptCodes, IFNULL(SUM(ti.NET_SALES), 0) AS netAll, IFNULL(SUM(IF(YEAR(q.ISSUE_DT) = YEAR(CURDATE()), ti.NET_SALES, 0)), 0) AS netCur, MIN(q.ISSUE_DT) AS firstDt, MAX(q.ISSUE_DT) AS lastDt FROM JOB_TB j INNER JOIN QUO_TB q ON q.QUO_YM = j.QUO_YM AND q.QUO_SEQ = j.QUO_SEQ AND q.STATE <> 'D' INNER JOIN TEST_ITEM_TB ti ON ti.QUO_YM = j.QUO_YM AND ti.QUO_SEQ = j.QUO_SEQ AND ti.STATE <> 'D' LEFT JOIN CMPY_TB c ON c.CMPY_SEQ = j.CMPY_SEQ WHERE j.STATE <> 'D' AND j.CMPY_SEQ > 0 AND q.ISSUE_DT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY j.CMPY_SEQ, cmpyName, bsnsRgnmb
SELECT TYPE_CD AS code, TYPE_NAME AS name FROM COMCODE_TB WHERE TOP_CD = 'TT' ORDER BY TYPE_CD
